date_note: Reported Nov 18; onset date not stated.
title: Wilmington School District 209U (Illinois) investigates possible ransomware attack and data breach
summary: Wilmington School District 209U in Illinois says it is investigating a possible ransomware attack and data breach, working with its cyber insurance team. District-issued laptops and other Windows devices are temporarily suspended; Chromebooks and phones still work. The district has not said whether any personal information was accessed.
plain: An Illinois school district says it may have been hit by ransomware and has switched off school laptops and Windows computers while it investigates.
exec: Local school district incident under investigation; no confirmed data theft yet.
action: Families and staff should watch for district notices and be alert to phishing that mentions the incident.
